title: Word Subsets
summary: Given two string arrays, words1 and words2, identify all strings in words1 that are universal.
statement: Given two string arrays, words1 and words2, identify all strings in words1 that are universal. A string in words1 is considered universal if every string in words2 is a subset of it, which means each character in the strings of words2 must appear in the universal string with at least the same frequency.
constraints: A word is universal when it contains every requirement with multiplicity.
Return universal words in any order.
hints: Combine all requirement words into one maximum-frequency demand.
A candidate passes when its count for every character meets that demand.
Build need[c]=max frequency across requirements, then filter candidates.
Meeting the coordinate-wise maximum is equivalent to meeting every individual requirement.
editorial: Meeting the coordinate-wise maximum is equivalent to meeting every individual requirement.

tests.explanation: Facebook, google, and leetcode contain both required letters.
Google is the only word containing e and two o characters.
